responsibility: Exercises the `ThinVec` collection’s basic iteration and collection interoperability, verifying that collecting from iterators and iterating by value, shared reference, and mutable reference produce the same observable element sequences as `Vec`, including empty and small-length cases.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `vec_map/tests.rs` or `sorted_map/tests.rs`, this file is a minimal sequence-container interoperability suite for `ThinVec`, checking that collecting from iterators and iterating by value, shared reference, and mutable reference match `Vec`’s element sequences.
